name: volume-reaches-core
description: Dragging the Quick volume rail updates mpv while the real slider continues to report its 0..1 level.

steps.name: hasVideo
steps.note: Wait for the live Quick VideoSession before sending a volume gesture.
Drag the actual Quick slider at its midpoint; the controller applies the real 0..1 input and sends the scaled value to mpv.
A bounded settle for the mpv write to be observable, not the synchroniser - the property comparison below is what decides the scenario.

assertions.note: The mpv session reports the same midpoint as the UI slider scaled to 0..100.
The real Quick volume slider exposes its controller-backed 0..1 level.
